title: ESTIMETR Entitlement Runtime and Source Line Reconciliation
description: รวมสองสายพัฒนาที่แยกจากกันกลับเป็นสายเดียว แล้วเปลี่ยน entitlement ของ ESTIMETR จากนโยบายบนกระดาษให้เป็นการบังคับใช้จริงฝั่งเซิร์ฟเวอร์ ตาม ADR 0003 คือสิทธิ์ทดลอง 5 วันนับจากวันสมัครสมาชิก บันทึกลง audit และตรวจสิทธิ์ก่อน render workspace ทุกครั้ง
scope: merge feature/estimeter-guided-assistant into the abuse-control line and keep the /apps/[slug] session guard
register ESTIMETR in the apps table from the code registry without a migration
issue the five-day trial from users.created_at with an audit event, idempotent under repeat and concurrent visits
resolve capabilities and project count on the server before rendering the ESTIMETR workspace
correct entitlement policy defaults that granted more than the approved trial
verification: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm test (45 passed / 3 opt-in skipped) and pnpm build pass on the reconciled line
entitlement unit tests cover AI default, stored limits on a paid entitlement, expired widening, future start date, suspension and the project cap

opt-in integration run against local PostgreSQL confirms one entitlement and one audit event per member, an unextendable window derived from users.created_at, read-only capabilities after five days and no duplicate row under concurrent first visits
GitHub push and release tag pending user approval
rollback: Return to tag v0.12.3-source-verification or branch backup/pre-estimeter-merge. No migration runs in this release, so a revert needs no schema rollback; rows written into apps, organizations, organization_members, app_entitlements and audit_events stay valid and unused.
constraints: No schema change or migration in this release; the runtime works on the tables shipped by migrations 0000 and 0001.
Trial activation starts a clock that cannot be reset, so it requires an explicit user action and an audit record.
Entitlement decisions are made on the server. Hiding a control in the UI is never the enforcement point.

items.title: Reconcile the ESTIMETR workspace line with intake abuse controls
